summary.description: The approach in markdown, at most 300 words: what you will change and why, open risks, and how it answers any earlier rejection. Andy reads it before approving.

plan.description: Your plan for the build, written read-only (procedure plan.md).

files.description: Files you planned to change or add, repo-relative paths.

steps.description: Order of work, one step each.

tests.description: Tests you planned to add or change, one each.

riskiestStep.description: The step most likely to go wrong, and why.

rejectedAlternatives.description: Approaches you considered and rejected, each with the reason.
